statement: The function returns a result r such that, for every byte vector v, v occurs as an element of r exactly once if and only if there exist cut positions 0 = p0 < p1 < p2 < p3 < p4 = len(s) satisfying: (1) for each k = 0,1,2,3, 1 <= p_{k+1} - p_k <= 3; (2) for each k = 0,1,2,3, if p_{k+1} - p_k > 1 then s[p_k] != 48 (the first digit of a multi-digit part is not '0'); (3) for each k = 0,1,2,3, the decimal value of s[p_k],...,s[p_{k+1}-1] is at most 255; and (4) v is the concatenation of s[p0..p1], byte 46 ('.'), s[p1..p2], byte 46, s[p2..p3], byte 46, and s[p3..p4], in that order. No order of the elements of r is required.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57 (s consists of ASCII decimal digits).

statement: For every s satisfying Pre(s), restore_ip_addresses(s) returns a result r (it does not fail by overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic); thus every returned-value claim below refers to this r.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every element v of r, 7 <= len(v) <= 15.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and every element v of r satisfies: v contains exactly three occurrences of byte 46 ('.'), and every byte of v is either 46 or an ASCII decimal digit with 48 <= byte <= 57.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and every element v of r satisfies: when v is split at its three '.' bytes, exactly four nonempty byte sequences are obtained; equivalently, v[0] != 46, v[len(v)-1] != 46, and no two consecutive bytes of v are both 46.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every element v of r, deleting all bytes equal to 46 ('.') from v yields exactly the byte sequence s (same length and same bytes in the same order).
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every element v of r, if v is written as p0 '.' p1 '.' p2 '.' p3 with each pi a byte sequence not containing 46, then 1 <= len(pi) <= 3 for i = 0,1,2,3.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every element v of r, for every dot-separated part p of v, if len(p) > 1 then p[0] != 48 (the ASCII code of '0').
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every element v of r, for every nonempty dot-separated part p of v, the decimal number represented by p, namely the sum over j with 0 <= j < len(p) of (p[j] - 48) * 10^(len(p)-1-j), is between 0 and 255 inclusive.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and every element v of r is obtainable from s by inserting exactly three dots: there exist cut positions 0 = p0 < p1 < p2 < p3 < p4 = len(s) such that 1 <= p_{k+1} - p_k <= 3 for k = 0,1,2,3, no multi-digit part begins with byte 48, each part has decimal value at most 255, and v is the dotted concatenation s[p0..p1] '.' s[p1..p2] '.' s[p2..p3] '.' s[p3..p4].
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every choice of cut positions 0 = p0 < p1 < p2 < p3 < p4 = len(s) satisfying (1) 1 <= p_{k+1} - p_k <= 3 for k = 0,1,2,3, (2) no part of length greater than 1 starts with byte 48, and (3) each part's decimal value is at most 255, the byte vector formed by the dotted concatenation s[p0..p1] '.' s[p1..p2] '.' s[p2..p3] '.' s[p3..p4] occurs as an element of r.
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(r), r[i] != r[j].
preconditions: Pre(s): s is a byte slice with 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 48 <= s[i] <= 57.
